scientific_integrity.originality_scope: Comparative assessment of specified incidence statement against cited public literature; independent historical-priority audit not yet performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact cumulative-pressure reduction, analytic sign-change argument, and rational logarithm interval certificates.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a deterministic closed SIR system with homogeneous mixing and infectiousness and two permanently fixed susceptibility values.
At least two strict maxima of new-infection incidence are proved, not an exact global number of incidence extrema.
The example is not a stochastic finite-population or real-epidemic forecast; historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Two risk classes suffice for recurrent incidence crests during rising SIR prevalence
